class.name: XRCamera3D
class.brief_description: A camera node which automatically positions itself based on XR tracking data.
class.description: A camera node which automatically positions itself based on XR tracking data. In contrast to [XRController3D], the render thread has access to more up-to-date tracking data, and the location of the [XRCamera3D] node can lag a few milliseconds behind what is used for rendering. [b]Note:[/b] If [member Viewport.use_xr] is [code]true[/code], most of the camera properties are overridden by the active [XRInterface]. The only properties that can be trusted are the near and far planes.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this node's transform is automatically updated with the tracking data of the head tracker. If [code]false[/code], the node is decoupled from the XR runtime and behaves like a regular [Camera3D] whose transform you set yourself. This is useful when the same scene is used to represent other players in a multiplayer game, where the transform is provided by the network instead of by the local XR runtime.
